newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Strong dollar keeps European feeds subdued.
newsitem.headline: Strong dollar keeps European feeds subdued.

text.p: A surging dollar restricted business on the European meals and feeds market to a few trades this afternoon, market sources said.
"The highest dollar since June 1994 kept a firm lid on business today and calls for a weaker Chicago soymeal futures opening also kept buyers sidelined," one broker said.

Spot Brazilian soymeal pellets traded at $309 a tonne fob Amsterdam. EU rapemeal traded as much as 0.75 marks up from yesterday on tight nearby supplies. Feb traded at 32 marks per 100 kg fob lower Rhine and Aug/Oct at 24.75 marks fob lower Rhine.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
